title: What should you do if your ball lands on the wrong green?
question: If your ball comes to rest on a putting green for a different hole than the one you’re playing, what are you required to do?

choices.text: Play your shot from the wrong green
Take a free drop off the wrong green
Move your ball with a one shot penalty

explanation: If your ball is on a wrong green, you must take free relief and drop off the green; you are not allowed to play the ball from the wrong green.
